trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum, awarded automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so treat it as a checklist of everything else in this guide rather than a task of its own. Work through the roadmap in order: story and missables first, then collectibles, activities and the money cleanup. Keep this tracker updated as you go so the final trophy is the only one left. When the last silver or gold pops, this one follows immediately.
steps: Finish the story and every missable
Clear the collectibles stage
Clear activities and money cleanup
Earn the final remaining trophy

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The official description ties this to completing Gone Fishing, the opening mission, so it unlocks through normal play at the very start of the story. Play through the prologue carefully and let the mission finish — do not skip the closing scenes, and let the game save afterwards. Because it is the first mission, it cannot be skipped if you start a new game from the beginning. If it ever fails to pop, reloading the autosave from the mission's end is the standard fix.
steps: Start a new game
Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing
Let the game save afterwards

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: The official description ties this to completing Chapter 1, the first full chapter after the prologue. Simply follow the main story markers and finish every required mission in the chapter; the trophy pops as the chapter closes. Keep a separate manual save at the chapter's end in case you want a clean point to return to later. No side content is required for this one, so do not delay it with collectibles.
steps: Follow the main story markers
Finish every required Chapter 1 mission
Keep a manual save at the chapter's end

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: The official description ties this to completing Chapter 2, so steady story progress is the whole method. Follow the main markers through the chapter and finish its required missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Start any stranger strands that appear along the way, because their finales are flagged missable elsewhere in this guide. Keep a fresh manual save when the chapter ends.
steps: Follow the main story markers
Finish every required Chapter 2 mission
Start stranger strands as they appear

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: The official description ties this to completing Chapter 3, the chapter whose title points at the return to Vice City. Play the chapter's required missions in story order and let the closing sequence finish before you turn back to side content. By this point several activity and stranger trophies should be underway; none of them are needed for this chapter milestone itself. Save manually when the chapter closes so your cleanup later starts from a known point.
steps: Follow the main story markers
Finish every required Chapter 3 mission
Keep a manual save at the chapter's end

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: The official description ties this to completing Chapter 4, so the method is the same disciplined story progress as the earlier chapters. Finish the chapter's required missions in order and let the ending play out fully. Before the finale chapters, take stock in this tracker: any named-mission or stranger-finale trophy still unearned deserves attention while the story is still open. Keep a manual save at the chapter's end.
steps: Follow the main story markers
Finish every required Chapter 4 mission
Review missables before moving on

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The official description ties this gold trophy to completing the final mission, so it arrives at the end of the main story. Before starting the finale, keep a separate manual save — finales in this series can involve choices, and a pre-finale save is cheap insurance even though the description names no branching requirement. Finish the mission and let the credits and the post-mission save complete. Afterwards the open world remains available for cleanup toward 100 percent.
steps: Keep a manual save before the finale
Complete the final mission
Let the credits and save complete

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: The official description ties this to completing the named mission Breakfast Run. Because it is a specific named mission rather than a chapter milestone, treat it as missable: keep a manual save before starting it and do not overwrite that save until the trophy pops. Play the mission through to its end screen rather than quitting mid-mission. If the mission fails, retry from the checkpoint instead of abandoning it, so the completion registers on this save.
steps: Keep a manual save before the mission
Start Breakfast Run when it is offered
Play it through to the end screen

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The official description ties this to completing the named mission The Cartel Heist. Because it is a specific named mission rather than a chapter milestone, treat it as missable: keep a manual save before the heist begins and finish any preparation the mission asks for before committing. Play the heist through its getaway and closing sequence; a heist is only complete when the mission itself ends. If a setup choice is offered, pick one and see it through rather than restarting to test the other.
steps: Keep a manual save before the heist
Finish any preparation the mission asks for
Complete The Cartel Heist including its getaway

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: The official description ties this to completing the named mission Child's Play. Because it is a specific named mission rather than a chapter milestone, treat it as missable: keep a manual save before starting it and do not overwrite that save until the trophy pops. Follow the mission's objectives to its end screen instead of leaving partway through. If the mission fails, retry from the checkpoint so the completion registers on this same save.
steps: Keep a manual save before the mission
Start Child's Play when it is offered
Play it through to the end screen

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: The official description ties this to completing the named mission Headliners. Because it is a specific named mission rather than a chapter milestone, treat it as missable: keep a manual save before starting it and do not overwrite that save until the trophy pops. Play the mission through to its end screen rather than quitting mid-mission. If the mission fails, retry from the checkpoint instead of abandoning it, so the completion registers on this save.
steps: Keep a manual save before the mission
Start Headliners when it is offered
Play it through to the end screen

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: The official description ties this to completing the named mission VCIA Takedown, set at VCIA. Because it is a specific named mission, treat it as missable: keep a manual save before starting it. While you are at VCIA for this mission, also remember Catch Me If You Can, whose description points at an unscheduled departure from the same place. Finish the takedown mission through to its end screen so the completion registers.
steps: Keep a manual save before the mission
Complete VCIA Takedown
Watch for the VCIA departure trophy while there

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: The official description ties this to completing the named mission Operation Savage Glory. Because it is a specific named mission rather than a chapter milestone, treat it as missable: keep a manual save before starting it and do not overwrite that save until the trophy pops. Stock up before you begin if the mission allows preparation, then play it through to its end screen. If the mission fails, retry from the checkpoint so the completion registers on this save.
steps: Keep a manual save before the mission
Prepare and stock up if the mission allows
Complete Operation Savage Glory

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The official description ties this gold trophy to attaining 100 percent completion, which means finishing the game's full completion checklist, not just the story. Use the in-game completion tracker after the story and work category by category: missions, collectibles, activities and exploration all feed the same percentage. The collectible and activity trophies in this guide cover most of what the percentage is built from. Save this for the cleanup stage, and check the percentage after each session so nothing is left ambiguous at 99 percent.
steps: Finish the story first
Work the in-game completion checklist by category
Check the percentage after each session

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: The official description sets the target at 250 stunts, making this a long-haul count trophy rather than a single feat. Build it into normal driving: take jumps, ramps and airtime opportunities whenever you cross the map instead of travelling past them. Stunt opportunities are spread across Leonida, and exploration for other trophies will naturally pass many of them. Note your counter in this tracker and top it up in free roam during cleanup if you finish the story short of 250.
steps: Take jumps and ramps during normal driving
Note the counter in this tracker
Top up in free roam during cleanup

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The official description asks you to try each type of activity once, so breadth matters here, not mastery. As new activity icons appear on the map, sample each one a single time and note in this tracker which types you have touched. The starter listing data counts nine activity types, so if the trophy has not popped after a first pass, compare the in-game activity list against what you have tried. Save gold-medal mastery for The Shootist and the other activity trophies; this one only needs a first attempt at each type.
steps: Sample each new activity type once
Note the types tried in this tracker
Compare against the in-game activity list if it has not popped

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: The official description requires a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges, so this is a mastery trophy: learn each range's target pattern, then chase gold one challenge at a time. Practise with the weapon class each challenge specifies and restart immediately after a mistake rather than finishing a flawed run. The starter listing data counts 42 challenges, so pace this across several sessions during the activities stage. Gold here also sharpens the combat skills that help with Gunslinger and the robbery trophies.
steps: Learn each range's target pattern
Restart a run immediately after a mistake
Chase gold one challenge at a time

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: The official description requires winning a Top Fun Drone Race at every location, so this is a checklist of first-place finishes rather than a single race. Learn each course with a practice run, then rerun it immediately while the layout is fresh until you take first place. The starter listing data counts 14 locations; tick each one off in this tracker as you win it. Drone handling improves quickly with repetition, so later courses usually take fewer attempts than the first ones.
steps: Take a practice run on each course
Rerun immediately until you finish first
Tick each location off in this tracker

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: The official description sets the target at winning 20 different races, so variety counts: a win only advances the counter when it is a race you have not already won. Work through race markers across Leonida, favouring shorter races early while you learn the handling. If a race keeps beating you, swap or upgrade your vehicle and return later rather than repeating the same loss. Keep a note here of which races are already won so you do not waste time re-winning the same event.
steps: Work through race markers across Leonida
Favour shorter races early
Note each race won in this tracker

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: The official description ties this to beating Cal in a fishing challenge, a head-to-head activity rather than a story beat. Accept Cal's challenge when it is offered, learn the fishing timing on your first attempts, and focus on clean, completed catches rather than rushing the reel. If you lose, challenge him again — the description names no one-time window, so treat rematches as the intended path. It pairs naturally with the fishing theme of the opening mission, so try it early while those mechanics are fresh.
steps: Accept Cal's fishing challenge
Learn the timing on the first attempts
Rematch until you beat him

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: The official description asks you to complete an arcade game, so find an arcade cabinet in the open world and play one game through to its actual end rather than quitting mid-round. Choose the shortest or simplest cabinet game you find first; completion, not a high score, is what the description requires. If a game has several stages, keep going until the game itself ends and returns you to the cabinet screen. Mark it done in the tracker — it is one of the quickest activity trophies on the list.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in the open world
Pick the shortest game available
Play it through to its real end

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: The official description ties this to completing the final mission for Andy, which means finishing Andy's whole mission strand, not just meeting the character. Because it is a strand's final mission, treat it as missable: follow Andy's strand whenever it updates and keep a save before the finale. Stranger strands can sit unfinished for a long time, so check the map for Andy's marker whenever you finish a story chapter. The trophy pops when the final mission ends, not when the strand first appears.
steps: Start Andy's strand when its marker appears
Follow the strand as it updates
Keep a save before the final mission and complete it

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: The official description ties this to completing the final mission for Kenton, which means finishing Kenton's whole mission strand, not just meeting the character. Because it is a strand's final mission, treat it as missable: follow Kenton's strand whenever it updates and keep a save before the finale. Stranger strands can sit unfinished for a long time, so check the map for Kenton's marker whenever you finish a story chapter. The trophy pops when the final mission ends, not when the strand first appears.
steps: Start Kenton's strand when its marker appears
Follow the strand as it updates
Keep a save before the final mission and complete it

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: The official description ties this to completing the final mission for Billy, which means finishing Billy's whole mission strand, not just meeting the character. Because it is a strand's final mission, treat it as missable: follow Billy's strand whenever it updates and keep a save before the finale. Stranger strands can sit unfinished for a long time, so check the map for Billy's marker whenever you finish a story chapter. The trophy pops when the final mission ends, not when the strand first appears.
steps: Start Billy's strand when its marker appears
Follow the strand as it updates
Keep a save before the final mission and complete it

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: The official description requires completing 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida, so this silver trophy is the sum of the individual stranger finales elsewhere in this guide. Start strands as soon as their markers appear and finish them promptly — the finales for characters such as Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each advance this counter. Keep count in this tracker, because the game spreads strands across the whole state and they are easy to lose track of. If you reach the cleanup stage short of eight, sweep the map region by region for unfinished stranger markers.
steps: Start stranger strands as markers appear
Finish the individual finales
Sweep region by region if you are short of eight

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: The official description ties this to completing the final mission for Randy, which means finishing Randy's whole mission strand, not just meeting the character. Because it is a strand's final mission, treat it as missable: follow Randy's strand whenever it updates and keep a save before the finale. Stranger strands can sit unfinished for a long time, so check the map for Randy's marker whenever you finish a story chapter. The trophy pops when the final mission ends, not when the strand first appears.
steps: Start Randy's strand when its marker appears
Follow the strand as it updates
Keep a save before the final mission and complete it

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: The official description ties this to completing the final mission for Tyrone, which means finishing Tyrone's whole mission strand, not just meeting the character. Because it is a strand's final mission, treat it as missable: follow Tyrone's strand whenever it updates and keep a save before the finale. Stranger strands can sit unfinished for a long time, so check the map for Tyrone's marker whenever you finish a story chapter. The trophy pops when the final mission ends, not when the strand first appears.
steps: Start Tyrone's strand when its marker appears
Follow the strand as it updates
Keep a save before the final mission and complete it

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The official description asks you to meditate at every spot across Leonida, making this a pure collectible sweep. When you find a meditation spot, use it immediately and tick the area off here, because these spots are easy to walk past and hard to remember later. The starter listing data counts 18 spots spread across the state, so combine the hunt with exploration for The Goodtime State. Leave any stragglers to a dedicated cleanup run with the map divided into regions.
steps: Use each meditation spot the moment you find it
Tick the area off in this tracker
Sweep region by region for stragglers

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: The official description ties this to hunting a unique animal for Bret, and the word unique is the warning: treat this as a one-time hunt and keep a manual save before you set out. Follow Bret's strand until the hunt is offered, prepare before tracking the animal, and do not leave the hunt half-finished. If the animal escapes or the hunt fails, reload rather than assuming it will be offered again in the same form. The trophy should pop when the hunt is handed in to Bret.
steps: Follow Bret's strand until the hunt is offered
Keep a manual save before setting out
Complete the hunt and hand it in to Bret

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: The official description requires completing 3 Collectible Card sets, so collecting individual cards only matters as it finishes whole sets. Prioritise finishing a set over starting a new one: track which set is closest to complete and hunt its missing cards first. Cards are hidden across Leonida, so combine card hunting with the exploration and meditation sweeps to cover the same ground once. When the third set is completed the silver trophy pops — partial sets give no partial credit.
steps: Track which set is closest to complete
Hunt that set's missing cards first
Finish three whole sets

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: The official description sets the target at WAiNK It at 100 locations, a long collectible-style counter built from repeating one action in many places. The description does not define the action beyond its name, so learn what WAiNK It means when the game introduces it, then do it whenever a new location offers the chance. Treat it like the stunt counter: little and often during normal play beats a single grinding session at the end. Use this tracker to note the regions you have already covered so the last locations are easy to find.
steps: Learn the action when the game introduces it
Repeat it at every new location
Note covered regions in this tracker

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: The official description sets the target at completing 50 Challenges, so steady breadth wins: accept challenges as they appear instead of saving them all for cleanup. Mix challenge types while you play, because a counter built on completions across the game rewards variety over repeating one easy challenge. Check your challenge total after each session and note it here. If you finish the story short, the remaining challenges become an early cleanup task before the 100 percent push.
steps: Accept challenges as they appear
Mix challenge types while you play
Note your total after each session

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: The official description describes losing a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escaping the heat, so this is a free-roam feat you set up deliberately. Raise your wanted level to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear completely. Stay together during the escape — splitting up risks the partner condition the description names. Open ground outside dense city blocks makes the final cooldown easier to survive without drawing police attention again.
steps: Raise a 4-star wanted level with your partner present
Break line of sight together
Hide until the stars clear completely

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: The official description requires robbing 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level, so plan a tight route of three nearby shops before you start. Rob the first, move straight to the second and third without hiding long enough for the wanted level to drop, and keep your partner with you throughout. The risk is the opposite of a normal escape: do not break line of sight for long between shops. Once the third robbery registers and you finally escape, the trophy is earned.
steps: Plan a route of three nearby shops
Rob them back-to-back with your partner
Keep the wanted level alive, then escape

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: The official description sets the target at discovering 100 vehicles, which rewards variety over value: encountering new models is what matters. Swap cars often instead of keeping one favourite, and take detours through different districts, since different areas spawn different traffic. Vehicles tied to missions and activities add to your exposure as well, so story progress helps here too. If you end short, a cleanup drive through several districts in different vehicles usually closes the gap quickly.
steps: Swap vehicles often
Drive through different districts
Close the gap with a cleanup drive if needed

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: The official description requires taking down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus, so you need one crowded fight and the ability fully ready. Wait for a mission or encounter with at least five enemies grouped closely, activate Combat Focus once, and prioritise quick, certain takedowns over perfect shots. If an attempt ends at three or four, reload the encounter rather than spending the ability elsewhere. Shooting Range practice from The Shootist builds exactly the aiming speed this needs.
steps: Find an encounter with five or more enemies
Activate Combat Focus once
Prioritise quick, certain takedowns

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: The official description describes making an unscheduled departure at VCIA, and it shares its location with the VCIA Takedown mission, so treat it as missable and keep a save from around that mission. While at VCIA, look for a way to leave that the game does not schedule for you — an improvised exit outside the mission's scripted path. The honest basis is the description itself: it rewards an unscheduled departure, not a story completion. Try it during the VCIA visit first; if the moment passes, your earlier save is the fallback.
steps: Keep a save from around the VCIA mission
Look for an unscheduled way to leave VCIA
Reload the save if the moment passes

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The official description is a joke — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — and Rhinos are this series' name for tanks, so the description ties this trophy to an encounter involving tanks. Treat it as missable: when tanks appear in a mission or set-piece, engage with the encounter instead of fleeing it, and keep a save from before the sequence. Use heavy weapons or a vehicle rather than small arms if the game gives you the choice. Because the description gives no count, one full tank encounter completed as the game intends is the working target.
steps: Keep a save before tank sequences
Engage with the tank encounter instead of fleeing
Use heavy weapons or a vehicle if offered

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The official description requires robbing a jewelry store without being detected, so preparation matters more than firepower. Scope the store first, approach quietly, and avoid any action that raises an alarm or draws a witness response before the robbery is done. If you are spotted, leave and reset rather than forcing it — detection voids the condition even if the robbery itself succeeds. A clean run is short: get in, take what the robbery requires, and get out unseen.
steps: Scope the store before entering
Rob it quietly without raising an alarm
Leave and reset if you are detected

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: The official description requires robbing 5 Bank Vaults and escaping, making this a repeated-heist trophy rather than a single set-piece. Learn the vault routine on the first bank — entry, vault, exit route, and losing the heat afterwards — because the escape is part of the requirement. Vary your target banks so each robbery counts as its own vault. Skills from Retail Therapy and A Classic Blitz Play transfer directly, so do this in the activities stage once those feel comfortable.
steps: Learn the full vault routine on the first bank
Rob five different bank vaults
Escape after each one

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: The official description requires robbing an Armored Truck and escaping, a single complete crime with two halves: the robbery and the getaway. When you spot an armored truck in free roam, plan your escape route before you strike, because the response comes fast. Break the truck open using the method the game presents, take the money, and drive the planned route until the heat clears. If the escape fails, the robbery alone is not enough — wait for the next truck and run the whole sequence again.
steps: Plan an escape route before striking
Rob the armored truck
Drive the route until the heat clears

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: The official description asks you to explore all of Leonida, so this is the map-completion companion to the collectible sweeps. The starter listing data counts 52 areas; uncovered map is the surest guide, so travel into any district you have not visited whenever you cross the state. Combine this with meditation spots, cards and stunts so every trip uncovers ground for several trophies at once. Near the end, scan the map for any pocket you never entered and make one deliberate trip to close it.
steps: Travel into unvisited districts as you cross the state
Combine trips with other collectible sweeps
Make a final trip to any pocket never entered

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: The official description requires robbing an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang, so the checklist is one successful robbery per gang, not many robberies of one gang. The starter listing data counts 9 gangs; note in this tracker which gangs you have already hit, because the operations themselves can look similar. Learn to identify which gang owns an operation before you rob it, so you do not waste risk on a duplicate. Finish the set during cleanup by targeting only the gangs still missing.
steps: Identify which gang owns an operation before robbing it
Note each gang hit in this tracker
Target only the missing gangs in cleanup

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The official description describes enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, which reads as a specific scene rather than a repeatable activity, so treat it as missable. When a story sequence or visit takes you to Ocean Beach, take the cocktail moment when it is offered instead of rushing the objective. Keep a save from before beach sequences if you are unsure which one carries it. The honest basis is the description's own wording: a named place, a named drink, and a view — a set-piece combination.
steps: Keep a save before Ocean Beach sequences
Take the cocktail moment when it is offered
Do not rush past the scene objective

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The official description describes smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style, a one-off set-piece image rather than a repeatable feat, so treat it as missable. When a mission or encounter puts you inside a vehicle showroom with a car available, driving out through the glass is the moment the description is pointing at. Keep a save before showroom sequences so a missed exit can be retried. Do not overthink the 'classic style' wording — the description rewards the smash itself.
steps: Keep a save before showroom sequences
Get into a car inside the showroom
Drive out through the glass

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The official description points you at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and asks for a follow-through there, so visit the alley and actually bowl rather than just entering the building. Play a game through to completion, paying attention to any prompt the alley gives you, since the trophy wording is playful rather than literal. The description names no score target, so a finished game at the named alley is the working requirement. It sits naturally in the activities stage alongside the arcade game.
steps: Visit the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley
Play a game through to completion
Follow any prompt the alley gives you

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — so the honest reading is a partner-related moment the game presents as a shared achievement. Treat it as missable: when partner set-pieces or joint activities are offered, do them rather than skipping ahead, and keep rotating saves during partner-heavy chapters. Because no count or location is stated, no specific step can be cited; the method is simply to engage with partner content as it appears. If it has not popped by the finale, your chapter saves are the way back.
steps: Do partner set-pieces when they are offered
Keep rotating saves in partner-heavy chapters
Use chapter saves to revisit if needed

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The official description — 'Choices made (for better or worse)' — ties this trophy to the choices you make through the story, so treat your decisions as the collectible here. Make deliberate choices whenever the game offers them instead of skipping dialogue, and vary your approach when a choice is repeatable. The starter listing data notes that the platform tracks choices toward a total, so steady engagement across the whole game matters more than any single decision. It is flagged missable in this tracker because story choices cannot be revisited without an earlier save.
steps: Make deliberate choices instead of skipping dialogue
Engage with choices across the whole game
Keep saves before major story decisions

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The official description says 'Second time's the charm', which points to succeeding at something on a second attempt after a first failure. Treat it as missable in method: when a check, attempt or challenge can fail, a genuine retry is what the wording rewards, so do not reload instantly after every failure. Let a failed attempt stand, try again, and succeed — that fail-then-succeed shape is the honest reading of the description. No location is named in the description, so no specific spot can be cited for this one.
steps: Let a failed attempt stand instead of reloading instantly
Retry the same attempt
Succeed on the second try

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The official description asks 'What the hell just happened?', marking this as a witness-something-strange trophy in this series' tradition of odd encounters. Treat it as missable: explore off the main path, especially during the exploration sweeps, and investigate anything unusual the game draws your attention to rather than driving past. No location is stated in the description, so none can honestly be cited here. When something genuinely strange happens and the moment registers, this is the trophy that should pop.
steps: Explore off the main path during sweeps
Investigate anything unusual instead of driving past
Keep exploring if it has not popped

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The official description defines this precisely: bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by, so you need to knock a person down using a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Set it up in a quiet area with a pedestrian nearby, build a little speed, and time the melee swing as you pass. It may take a few passes to connect cleanly, so pick a spot where you can loop around and retry. Despite the bowling name, it has nothing to do with the bowling alley trophy.
steps: Find a quiet spot with a pedestrian nearby
Build a little speed in a vehicle
Time a melee swing as you pass

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: The official description sets a money target: earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. This is a cleanup-stage grind, so start routing marked bills to your contacts whenever the game offers them rather than saving the whole total for the end. Keep a running note of your laundered total here, because six-figure targets are easy to underestimate mid-game. Once your contacts and income streams are established after the story, focused laundering sessions close the remaining gap.
steps: Route marked bills to contacts whenever offered
Note your laundered total in this tracker
Grind the remainder in cleanup sessions

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: The official description sets the target at spending $100,000 across all shops, which normal play goes a long way toward on its own. Clothing, vehicles, weapons and services all feed the same habit: buy what you actually need instead of hoarding cash. Do not rush this early, when money is tight; the activities and cleanup stages give you income first. If you finish everything else short of the total, a deliberate shopping round across several shops closes it without waste.
steps: Buy what you need instead of hoarding cash
Let income grow before chasing the total
Close any gap with a round across several shops

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: The official description requires purchasing all garage properties, so this is a property checklist gated by money. The starter listing data counts 8 garage properties; buy them as your income grows rather than saving for all eight at once, since garages are useful while you play. Keep a list here of which garages you own, because property markers are easy to confuse across the map. The last purchases usually land in the cleanup stage, once laundering and robbery income is flowing.
steps: Buy garages as your income grows
List the garages you own in this tracker
Finish the set in the cleanup stage

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The official description requires registering 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, a small collectible counter built from vehicles you encounter. Register vehicles as you acquire or discover them instead of leaving all ten for the end; it pairs naturally with discovering 100 vehicles for Whip It Good. Use different vehicles rather than re-registering favourites, since the count is of vehicles registered. Ten is a modest total, so most players will finish this during normal story and activity play.
steps: Register vehicles as you discover them
Use different vehicles each time
Reach ten registered vehicles
